nodes.description: Not a cause of the disease - this is a Mendelian disorder - but the trigger that converted compensated disease into decompensation in two of the four published patients. The index patient's cardiomyopathy declared itself during a viral illness at fifteen months, and the leukodystrophy patient's developmental regression is described as worsening markedly after an infection. That is the familiar catabolic-stress pattern of mitochondrial disease, reported here in two unrelated presentations.

nodes.description: NDUFAF1 does not work alone. It is one of four core components of the mitochondrial complex I intermediate assembly (MCIA) complex, with ECSIT, ACAD9 and TMEM126B, and that complex builds the ND2 module of complex I. Knocking out any one component is enough to impair complex I assembly, which is why an assembly-factor gene behaves like a structural one clinically.
